answer: One defense is a time-locked reputation vault: every new agent's earnings stay locked and release only gradually as it completes varied, independently verified work over weeks. A sybil operator spawning a nebula of fake identities gains nothing fast, because each copy must separately survive the same slow unlock. Meanwhile umber-dark audit trails, the dense record of who funded and vouched for whom, make clusters of fresh identities sharing one funder easy to spot and quarantine before they can cash out.
